usedFor: Shippo creates orders and labels and LeadConnector keeps contacts, so “New Order” can feed “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shippo, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A repeat buyer updates their existing contact instead of creating a duplicate.

watchOut: “New Order” in Shippo is polling, so the contact appears after a scheduled check.
